name: jev-reflection
description: Uses TypeSafe Jev as an in-task navigator with neutral checkpoints and advisory reflection.

interface.longDescription: TypeSafe Jev combines independent tool observations with agent checkpoints to suggest reflection on focus, causes versus symptoms, critical assumptions and costly dependent work, pace and perspective. Perspective asks a clean-context supervisor to inspect intermediate results for omissions and meaningful improvements. A minimalist progress bar shows Jev's rough estimate of completed planned work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain when Jev Reflection intervenes and what the agent must reflect on.
